brief.scope: Adjudicate the supplied original review against this exact original snapshot. Read the report verbatim and the artifact it reviewed; do not inspect later refs, live repositories, later reviews, fixes, concessions or other dispatch state. Rule UPHELD/PARTIAL/REJECTED on every finding, grounded in commands against this snapshot, then state what the reviewer missed separately. No edits to the snapshot, tests, runtime, full floor, vendor call or authority change. Write the complete ruling to out/RULING.md and name it in artifacts; return a valid review envelope with exact SHA and bounded remedies. findings.claim: UPHELD. Trusted boot grants tools/lane_refs.py as one of four components, loads those bytes before the first v3 acquisition, and hashes the file into the three-file adapter manifest, while Fixed acquisition boundary still calls it proposed and absent until step 2; the named range lands the 914-line file. Retire that absence language, or state in one sentence that the grant applies only once step 2 has made the instrument present and that v3 reads refuse until then.

Name the single module that exports acquire and use one of adapter or coordinator in both documents.
